topic: Plans & the future + be going to / be coming / will（未來計畫＋未來式三種說法陷阱）

shadow.speaker: Tsai Ing-wen 蔡英文（2025 年 11 月 10 日在德國柏林「Berlin Freedom Conference 柏林自由會議」的英文演講結尾；Berlin Freedom Conference 官方 YouTube）

chunks.text: Taiwan and all those that share our values
have a key role to play in ensuring that democracy prevails.
While it may seem like we are faced with unprecedented challenges,
I'm confident that by working together, we will create a bright future for free societies.

phrases.en: have a key role to play in + V-ing
phrases.zh: 在（做）某事上扮演關鍵角色
我有信心……會……（用 will 說對未來的預測和信心）

respond.prompt_en: What are you going to do this weekend, and what do you think will happen? Answer in one sentence.
respond.prompt_zh: 這個週末你打算做什麼？你覺得結果會怎樣？用一句英文回答（已經計畫好的用 be going to，預測/信心用 will！例如 I'm going to…, and I'm confident it will…）

vocab.example: In the end, truth will prevail over rumors.
vocab.note: 蔡英文原句：ensuring that democracy prevails。prevail over / against sth＝勝過……。形容詞 prevalent（普遍的、盛行的）。B2 常見字。

vocab.example: The typhoon brought unprecedented rain to the city.
vocab.note: 蔡英文原句：unprecedented challenges。拆字：un（不）+ precedent（先例）+ ed＝沒有先例的。重音在 PRE：un-PRE-ce-den-ted。

vocab.example: I'm confident that our class will win the relay race.
vocab.note: 蔡英文原句：I'm confident that… we will create…。⚠️ confident（有信心的）≠ confidential（機密的）。名詞 confidence：have confidence in sb。

vocab.example: Please double-check your answers to ensure there are no careless mistakes.
vocab.note: 蔡英文原句：in ensuring that democracy prevails。ensure (that) + 子句／ensure + N。⚠️ ensure 確保 vs insure 保險 vs assure sb 向某人保證（assure 後面接人）。

vocab.example: Are you ready for the upcoming exam in December?
vocab.note: 只能放在名詞前：the upcoming test（✗ The test is upcoming 較少用）。說「快到了」用 be coming：Christmas is coming（114 會考考點）。

grammar.title: 未來的說法：be going to／be coming（現在進行式）／will，各用在哪？
grammar.explain:
108 年會考「___ that last piece of pie? If not, can I have it?」答對率只有 42%！會考很愛在「問句」和「已有的計畫」裡考未來式。
① be going to＋原形 V：事先就有的打算／計畫。問別人打不打算做：Are you going to eat that last piece of pie?（108 會考）
② be＋V-ing（現在進行式）表示「已安排好、快要發生」：Christmas is coming.（114 會考：聖誕節快到了）；Annie is going to meet us this weekend（111 補考：已經約好的事）。
③ will＋原形 V：說話當下才決定、承諾、主動提議：Sure, honey. I'll wait for you at the school gate.（111 補考：爸爸當場答應）；也用在預測和信心：I'm confident that we will create a bright future.
④ 陷阱：看到 this weekend／tomorrow 就要用未來；選 Do you eat / meets（現在簡單式）通常是習慣，不是這一次的計畫；I wait for / I'm waiting for 不能表示「答應明天做」。
🔑 判斷法：之前就計畫好 → be going to；已安排、快到了 → be V-ing；現在才決定／答應／預測 → will。
⭐ 蔡英文原句：I'm confident that by working together, we will create a bright future for free societies.（表達信心和預測 → will）
examples: Are you going to eat that last piece of pie? If not, can I have it? —— 108 會考：問對方的打算 → be going to（答對率 42%）
Christmas is coming, and I want to visit my aunt abroad. —— 114 會考：快到了 → is coming
I'm confident that by working together, we will create a bright future for free societies. —— 蔡英文原句：信心／預測 → will

practice.question: A: Oh, the phone is ringing, and my hands are wet. B: Don't worry. ___ it for you.
practice.explanation: B 是「聽到電話響、當下才決定幫忙」→ 用 will：I'll answer it for you. I answer 是習慣；I answered 是過去；I'm answering 是正在做／已安排，不是當場的主動提議。

uoe.passage: Our school's sports day ___1___ next Friday, and everyone in my class is excited. Last month we decided on a plan: we ___2___ a dance at the opening show, and we have practiced it every day since then. Yesterday our teacher smiled and said, "I'm ___3___ that you will do a great job." Then my best friend Amy told me she had left her costume at her grandma's house. "Don't worry," I said right away. "I ___4___ you my spare one."

gaps.explanation: next Friday＝還沒到、但已排定快要來 → 現在進行式表未來 is coming（114 會考考法：Christmas is coming）。came／was coming 是過去；has come 表示已經來了。
上個月就決定好的計畫，表演還沒發生（在 next Friday）→ be going to。performed／have performed 都表示已經表演過了。
I'm confident that…＝我有信心……（蔡英文原句同樣句型）。unprecedented 前所未有的、upcoming 即將到來的，意思不合；prevailed 是動詞，不能放在 I'm 後面。
right away＝當下才決定幫忙、主動提議 → will：I'll lend you my spare one。lent／have lent 表示已經借了；was lending 是過去進行式。

quiz.question: ___ that last piece of pie? If not, can I have it? I didn't eat much this morning.
quiz.explanation: 問對方「打不打算吃最後那塊派」→ 未來的打算用 be going to：Are you going to eat…? Do you eat 是問習慣；Had you eaten／Were you eating 是過去。全國答對率只有 42%！

quiz.question: Christmas ___ and I want to visit my aunt abroad. Do you have any plans yet?
quiz.explanation: 問 Do you have any plans yet? → 聖誕節還沒到、快要來了 → 現在進行式表未來 is coming。came／was coming 是過去；comes 是一般事實，不表示「快到了」。

quiz.question: Annie ___ us this weekend? Why didn't you tell me earlier? I really want to see her, but I've told Grandpa I'll help him on the farm.
quiz.explanation: this weekend 還沒到，是已經安排好的見面 → is going to meet。met／has met 表示已經見過了，和 I really want to see her 矛盾；meets 是習慣。

quiz.question: Diana: Dad, could you pick me up around six tomorrow evening? I have classes until then. Charles: Sure, honey. ___ you at the school gate.
quiz.explanation: 爸爸「當下答應」明天去接 → 承諾用 will：I'll wait for you。I wait for 是習慣；I'm waiting for 是現在正在等；I waited for 是過去。

quiz.question: The heavy rain last night caused ___ flooding. Nothing like it had ever happened in our town before.
quiz.explanation: Nothing like it had ever happened before＝以前從沒發生過 → unprecedented（前所未有的）。confident 有信心的；upcoming 即將到來的（昨晚已發生，不合）；reliable 可靠的。

quiz.question: Before you hand in the test, check your answers again to ___ that there are no careless mistakes.
quiz.explanation: ensure that…＝確保……。⚠️ insure 是「投保」，拼法很像是陷阱！prevail 獲勝；exaggerate 誇大，都不合。

dialog.greet: Good morning, Roby! Ready for a new day? 早安，Roby！今天也一起加油吧！
dialog.present: Today: talking about the future — going to, will, or -ing? 今天的重點：說未來的三種方法！
correct: Excellent! You picked the right future form. 太棒了，未來式選對了！
Well done — that's exactly right! 完全正確，好厲害！
Great job! The trap didn't catch you. 很好，陷阱沒騙到你！
wrong: Almost! Was it planned before, or decided just now? 差一點！是事先計畫好的，還是當下才決定的？
No worries — mistakes help us learn. 沒關係，錯誤會讓我們進步。
Look for the time words: this weekend, tomorrow, next Friday. 找找時間線索喔！
dialog.hint: Plan → be going to. Arranged and coming soon → be + V-ing. Deciding or promising now → will. 計畫用 going to，已安排用進行式，當下決定用 will。
dialog.submit: Let's check your answers together. 我們一起來對答案吧！
dialog.done: You worked hard today — I'm confident you'll do great on your exam! 你今天很認真，段考一定沒問題！
